citation: ITU-R P.525-4 §6.1; Friis IRE Proc. May 1946
notes: Phase 2 deliverable — these values will be regenerated from the Python `itur` library and ITU-R P.525-4 §6.2 worked examples once the fixture-generation script lands at tools/rf-fixtures/gen_itur.py.
Until then, expected values are computed from the closed-form ITU constant 32.44778322188337 = 20·log10(4π·1e9/c) at full IEEE-754 double precision.
Tolerance is 1e-3 dB so the same fixture passes against both the closed-form constant and any external library that uses the rounded ITU constant 32.4 or 32.45.
